baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain 'your Lord knows ... God measures ... He knew you would not enumerate it ... recite what is easy' joins exact divine knowledge to bounded human performance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Exact measure remains with God; failed human enumeration triggers an accessible recited portion rather than cancellation of observance.

activation_trace.role: The branch's disclosure of a thing to the knower makes actual effort and limitation fully visible to divine knowledge.
Measured deliberative governance supplies the exact calibration assigned to God.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning names the human operation declared unsustainable.
Reading and recitation provide the repeatable practice retained after exact duration is relinquished.
Opening and ease after difficulty make availability, rather than a fixed quantity, the operative limit.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely relaxes a quantified night requirement because exact compliance failed.
changed_reading.after: It relocates exactness to divine measuring while giving humans an accessible, repeatable form of observance; accommodation preserves the practice by changing its human unit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A group stands with the addressee, while the sick, travelers seeking bounty, fighters, worshippers, almsgivers, and lenders occupy different conditions under the repeated easy-recitation rule.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah organizes a plural community by capacity and vocation: common recital accompanies differentiated bodily, economic, defensive, ritual, and distributive work.

activation_trace.role: An encircling, gathered group gives the standing cohort a communal rather than solitary shape.
Weakening and curtailed movement supply a bodily capacity constraint.
Striving through the land supplies mobile livelihood as a second capacity condition.
Active seeking makes travel purposive pursuit of provision rather than mere absence.
Mutual combat supplies the severe public obligation borne by another cohort.
Obligatory worship stabilizes a shared practice amid differing conditions.
A portion of wealth or work cut out for return turns capacity into transferable benefit.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists exceptions to night practice and then appends ordinary duties.
changed_reading.after: It maps a differentiated community whose illness, livelihood, defense, worship, and giving are distinct capacity-bearing channels held together by flexible recital.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inability to enumerate the night is followed by lending, sending good ahead, finding it with God, and receiving a greater wage.
baseline_models.mechanism: A failed temporal ledger is answered by a forward-transfer ledger: intentionally advanced good is preserved, encountered, and amplified beyond the performer's exact counting.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive counting supplies the ledger operation humans cannot complete for the vigil.
Cutting out property or work for a returned recompense supplies the deposit transaction.
Advancing ahead gives the good deed a temporal direction toward a later encounter.
Coming upon the thing again supplies retrieval rather than disappearance.
Payment for work names the returned value of the advance.
Magnitude and strength mark the return as amplified rather than merely restored.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds receive a later reward despite imperfect night observance.
changed_reading.after: What cannot be perfectly totalled as devotional time can still be deliberately advanced as good and later encountered as an enlarged recompense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Lord who knows the performers' limits turns toward them, names sickness, and closes the adjusted command with forgiveness and mercy.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship functions as nurture and repair: exposure of incompleteness leads to a practicable form, while forgiveness covers the performer from the deficit's effects.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship the governing care behind the adjustment.
Attending to the sick turns a listed exception into an image of active care.
Covering a fault and protecting its bearer supplies the protective function of forgiveness.
Tender mercy gives the closing protection an affective and relational quality.

changed_reading.before: The final divine names merely pardon whatever remains deficient.
changed_reading.after: The whole adjustment is lordly repair: it keeps limited people inside practice, then protects rather than discards them for what remains incomplete.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening schedule permits subtraction and addition around a bounded night amount, yet orders the received heavy word into articulated recital and contrasts it with broad daytime livelihood. The focus ayah therefore shifts the controllable unit from elapsed night to the available portion of recitation.

activation_trace.role: Littleness supplies the opening schedule's first bounded reduction.
Removal of part makes downward adjustment an explicit operation.
Increase and growth supply the reciprocal upward adjustment.
Ordered arrangement makes recital internally articulated rather than an undifferentiated duration.
Literal heaviness preserves the seriousness of the word whose delivery is being adapted.
Room for going about and earning supplies the daytime pressure that makes portability necessary.
Repeated recitation becomes the divisible practice that can move across schedules.
Ease after difficulty sets availability as the new boundary of the recited portion.

structural_cues: 73:2-4 brackets a half-night with 'except a little,' decrease, and increase.
73:5-7 places a heavy saying and firm night practice against broad daytime movement; 73:20 repeats the fractions and then repeats 'what is easy.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjustable fractions, ordered recital, a heavy word, and daytime livelihood; I infer that 73:20 changes the human unit of compliance from duration to available recited portion. A live alternative is simple rescission of the earlier schedule without such a unit shift.

changed_reading.before: Easy recitation is a general concession after failed counting.
changed_reading.after: The easy portion is a portable unit that carries an ordered, still-heavy word through unstable schedules; ease changes dosage, not gravity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier daytime movement, devotional severance, and graceful separation create alternating poles of public motion and concentrated withdrawal. The focus ayah reintegrates recital into illness, livelihood, defense, communal worship, and transfer rather than making withdrawal permanent.

activation_trace.role: Capacity to range for livelihood supplies the outward-moving pole.
Cutting and separation supply the concentrated devotional pole.
Parting and separation extend withdrawal into the social field.
The gathered cohort prevents the final practice from remaining purely solitary.
Travel through the land carries recitation back into mobile livelihood.
Transfer made for return embeds devotion in material relations with others.

structural_cues: 73:7-10 moves from daytime range to exclusive turning and then graceful separation.
73:20 names a standing group and two repeated 'others' before joining recital to public and economic acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward livelihood, severance, social parting, and the focus ayah's plural roles; I infer a final reintegration of concentrated withdrawal with ordinary and public obligations. The live alternative is that the earlier separations are ethical attitudes, not a social or spatial rhythm.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah simply accommodates several independent life conditions.
changed_reading.after: It is a reintegration protocol after concentrated withdrawal: the recited word now travels through communal, bodily, economic, and defensive life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding witness-disobedience-seizure sequence places the focus ayah's knowing, ease, and forgiveness inside accountability. Adjustment is authoritative clemency, not the disappearance of command.

activation_trace.role: Presence with observation supplies the witnessed field in which obedience is evaluated.
Departure from obedience identifies the failure that the punitive example condemns.
Harmful severity and weight give disobedience a consequential endpoint.
Lordship, ownership, and authority ground the legitimacy of the revised command.
Full disclosure to the knower makes the accommodation informed rather than permissive guesswork.
Ease supplies the merciful scaling that remains inside that authority.

structural_cues: 73:15 establishes a messenger as witness; 73:16 immediately narrates disobedience and a severe taking.
73:20 retains imperatives after naming incapacity and closes with a request for forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness, disobedience, severe consequence, divine authority, and adjusted imperatives; I infer that flexibility is mercy within answerability. A live alternative is that the Pharaoh sequence concerns rejection of the messenger and does not qualify the later ritual adjustment.

changed_reading.before: The flexible rule might be read as suspension of a command that proved too difficult.
changed_reading.after: The rule is authoritative mercy under witnessed accountability: performance is scaled to capacity while answerability and imperative force remain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question about protection while disbelieving juxtaposes warding harm with human covering. The focus close reverses that relation: limits are admitted, forgiveness is sought, and divine covering protects the person from the fault's effect.

activation_trace.role: Repelling harm by protection supplies the shelter the rhetorical question denies.
Covering and concealment supply the failed human strategy set beside protection.
Divine covering of fault explicitly protects its bearer from the fault's consequence.
Tender mercy distinguishes protective covering from evasive concealment.

structural_cues: 73:17 places 'how will you protect yourselves' directly before 'if you disbelieve.'
73:20 openly names inability and sickness, then ends with 'seek forgiveness' and the names Forgiving and Merciful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, two distinct covering images, and an incapacity-to-forgiveness sequence; I infer a reversal from concealment that cannot shelter to admitted limitation met by divine shelter. A live alternative is that the shared covering image is only lexical resonance with no deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness compassionately closes the adjusted obligations.
changed_reading.after: The close offers the protection unavailable through concealment: human limits are exposed, then divine covering preserves the limited performer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular voluntary taking of a path to the Lord in 73:19 unfolds in 73:20 into plural embodied routes: standing, sickness, economic travel, combat, prayer, almsgiving, lending, and advancing good.

activation_trace.role: Taking as acquisition or adoption turns the path into an assumed practice.
Will attached to a thing supplies the singular agent's voluntary orientation.
An extended traversable road supplies the path image that the focus ayah pluralizes in practice.
Journeying through the land makes one route literally mobile.
Seeking gives that mobile route an economic purpose.
Mutual combat supplies a second, dangerous public route.
The repeated road image explicitly anchors one focus cohort in God's path.
Moving good forward makes ethical transfer another mode of traversal.

structural_cues: 73:19 has singular 'whoever wills' and 'takes ... a path'; 73:20 repeatedly names plural cohorts and actions.
The path root recurs in the focus ayah while movement through the earth and advancement of good add spatial and temporal directions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a voluntarily adopted singular path followed by repeated plural actors and directional acts; I infer that 73:20 embodies the path in several capacity-specific routes. A live alternative is that 73:19 is only a summary invitation and the following list is administrative detail.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah assigns one flexible devotion to people in different circumstances.
changed_reading.after: It unfolds the singular path to the Lord into multiple embodied routes, coordinated by common recital but not reduced to one schedule or vocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns raised solidity into a gathered heap that pours away and depicts the sky splitting. Against stores and structures that disaggregate, the focus ayah's loan and forward good are placed where they can later be found.

activation_trace.role: A raised solid accumulation supplies the apparently durable terrestrial store.
Matter gathered into a heap supplies the mountain's intermediate loss of solidity.
Pouring out measured material completes the image of a store that cannot retain itself.
Opening and splitting extend material failure from earth to sky.
A cut-out transfer for later return supplies movement away from an unstable present store.
Advancing good sends value beyond the collapsing present scene.
Finding the transferred good with God supplies durable retrieval.

structural_cues: 73:14 sequences earth's shaking, mountains, sandheap, and pouring looseness.
73:18 splits the sky; 73:20 says that good sent ahead will be found with God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disintegrating terrestrial and celestial structures plus transfer and retrieval language; I infer a contrast between unstable present storage and a good deposited beyond collapse. The live alternative is that the catastrophe is only a warning backdrop and does not specify the economics of the final verse.

changed_reading.before: Advancing good is a delayed-reward account.
changed_reading.after: Advancing good is also a transfer out of stores that cannot hold themselves into a custody where the giver can still find it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cited branch is form-distant from the immediate adjective in 73:10. It remains anchored because the packet explicitly preserves 'taking night as a camel for travel' while the focus ayah joins night, travel through the earth, and path. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as a translation of 'beautiful.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ayah links measured night activity with people traveling through the earth and acting in God's path.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally pictures taking night as a camel for travel and supplies the conveyance analogy.
Undertaking an affair at night anchors the imagined conveyance in the vigil.
Travel through the land gives the focus ayah a literal journey alongside the night practice.
The extended traversed road gives that conveyance a directional destination.

changed_reading.before: Night vigil and daytime travel are competing demands that require accommodation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, disciplined night becomes a conveyance rather than a stationary quota: its portable recitation carries the traveler along the wider path.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped branch from context root 'و ع د' to root_000989, not the ordinary promise branch. It remains valid as packet-provided branch material and attaches directly to the focus ayah's measuring, inability to enumerate, loan, and return. Downstream prose must label it a split-root resonance and must not claim that 'promise' lexically means 'count.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ayah contrasts divine measuring with failed human enumeration and then describes a loan whose advanced good is found again.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch literally supplies enumeration of the counted and activates a promise-as-ledger resonance.
Bringing about an act makes the promised account effectuated rather than merely announced.
Deliberative measuring places the final reckoning under divine administration.
Exhaustive counting marks the precise operation humans cannot sustain.
Transfer for returned recompense supplies the transaction recorded in the exploratory account.

changed_reading.before: The enacted promise precedes a separate concession and reward instruction.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, the enacted promise is also a counted account: it holds the total humans cannot keep and secures the return on what they advance.

strongest_changes: The opening schedule turns the final concession into a shift from measured duration to a portable recited portion, while the word remains heavy.
Earlier severance and daytime movement make 73:20 a reintegration of concentrated vigil with illness, livelihood, defense, worship, and giving.
The protection/covering sequence makes forgiveness the shelter that concealment cannot provide.
The singular path of 73:19 unfolds as multiple embodied routes in 73:20.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah repeatedly relocates functions humans cannot stabilize: exact counting moves to divine measure, a heavy word becomes available recited portions, solitary intensity enters distributed communal life, and unstable possessions become good advanced and found with God.
remaining_uncertainties: The material contrast between collapsing stores and preserved good is coherent but may be only an eschatological backdrop.
The earlier severance language may describe inward concentration and ethical distance rather than a social rhythm of withdrawal and return.
The non-dominant promise-to-count branch is useful only as an explicitly contained split-root resonance.
The scope of 'what is easy' may concern recited quantity, recited selection, or both.
